title: Miriam and Aaron Oppose Moses

questions.question: Why did Miriam and Aaron speak against Moses?
options: Because of the Cushite woman he had married
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the Cushite woman he had married
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:1 (ESV): "Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married..."

questions.question: What question did they ask regarding God speaking?
options: "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has he not spoken through us also?"
"Why does God not speak to us?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has he not spoken through us also?"
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:2 (ESV): "Has the Lord indeed spoken only through Moses? Has he not spoken through us also?"

questions.question: How is Moses described in this chapter?
options: Very meek, more than all people on earth
questions.correctAnswer: Very meek, more than all people on earth
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:3 (ESV): "Now the man Moses was very meek, more than all people who were on the face of the earth."

questions.question: How did God speak to prophets usually?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:6 (ESV): "If there is a prophet among you, I the Lord make myself known to him in a vision; I speak with him in a dream."

questions.question: How did God speak to Moses?
options: Mouth to mouth (face to face), clearly
questions.correctAnswer: Mouth to mouth (face to face), clearly
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:8 (ESV): "With him I speak mouth to mouth, clearly, and not in riddles..."

questions.question: What happened to Miriam as punishment?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:10 (ESV): "And behold, Miriam was leprous, like snow."

questions.question: How did Aaron react when he saw Miriam?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:11 (ESV): "And Aaron said to Moses, 'Oh, my lord, do not punish us...'"

questions.question: What was Moses' prayer for Miriam?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:13 (ESV): "And Moses cried to the Lord, 'O God, please heal her—please.'"

questions.question: How long was Miriam shut outside the camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:15 (ESV): "So Miriam was shut outside the camp seven days..."

questions.question: Did the people travel while Miriam was shut out?
options: No, the people did not set out till she was brought in again
questions.correctAnswer: No, the people did not set out till she was brought in again
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:15 (ESV): "And the people did not set out on the march till Miriam was brought in again."

questions.question: Where were they when this happened?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:16 (ESV): "After that the people set out from Hazeroth..." (Context of ch 11 end and ch 12 start).

questions.question: God said Moses is faithful in what?
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:7 (ESV): "He is faithful in all my house."

questions.question: What does God mention as a comparison for her shame (seven days)?
options: If her father had but spit in her face
questions.correctAnswer: If her father had but spit in her face
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:14 (ESV): "If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be shamed seven days?"

questions.question: Who stood at the entrance of the tent to rebuke Aaron and Miriam?
options: The Lord in a pillar of cloud
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord in a pillar of cloud
questions.explanation: Numbers 12:5 (ESV): "And the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent..."

questions.question: Why was Aaron not struck with leprosy too?
questions.explanation: Text does not explicitly state why, but Miriam seems the instigator (mentioned first) and Aaron confesses immediately.

key_verse_text: Now the man Moses was very meek, more than all people who were on the face of the earth.
